state/numerical-methods.json.title: Numerical Methods
state/numerical-methods.json.goal: Explain and solve linear systems, including singular cases.

course_context.assessment: Short oral explanations followed by worked problems.
constraints: No numerical calculator is needed for this exercise.
unknowns: The actual examination date and full permitted aids are unknown.

free-parameter.text: On worksheet A, choose the free variable y=t and express x in terms of t.

assessment-aid.text: For the Numerical Methods oral examination 2026/27, the official notice permits one A5 sheet of formulas, handwritten on one side. Worked derivations and worked solutions are not permitted. Calculator rules are not specified in this notice.
assessment-aid.attribution: Official oral examination notice released 23 September 2026.
